name: Steady red light
meaning: Come to a complete stop. You may turn right (and in some states left onto a one-way street) after stopping only if no sign prohibits it and it is safe.

name: Steady yellow light
meaning: The light is about to turn red. Stop if you can do so safely; if you are too close to stop safely, proceed with caution.

name: Steady green light
meaning: Go if the intersection is clear, yielding to pedestrians and to vehicles still in the intersection. When turning left, yield to oncoming traffic.

name: Flashing red light
meaning: Treat it like a stop sign: come to a complete stop, yield, and go only when it is safe.

name: Flashing yellow light
meaning: Slow down and proceed with caution; watch for cross traffic and pedestrians.

name: Green left-turn arrow
meaning: Protected left turn: you may turn left in the direction of the arrow; oncoming traffic is stopped. Still yield to pedestrians and vehicles in the intersection.

name: Steady yellow left arrow
meaning: The protected left-turn period is ending. Stop if you can do so safely, or complete the turn with caution if you are already in the intersection.

name: Red left arrow
meaning: Do not turn left. Stop and wait until a green arrow or a permissive signal allows the turn.

name: Flashing yellow left arrow
meaning: Left turns are allowed but not protected: yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians, then turn when there is a safe gap.

name: Green right-turn arrow
meaning: You may turn right in the direction of the arrow; yield to pedestrians and vehicles already in the intersection.

name: Pedestrian signal: walk
meaning: Pedestrians may start crossing. Drivers turning across the crosswalk must yield to them.

name: Pedestrian signal: don't walk
meaning: Pedestrians must not start crossing. Drivers should still watch for pedestrians finishing their crossing.

name: Pedestrian countdown signal
meaning: The number shows the seconds left to finish crossing. Pedestrians should not start crossing; drivers should expect pedestrians still in the crosswalk.

name: Lane-use signal: red X
meaning: Do not drive in this lane — it is closed to traffic in your direction.

name: Lane-use signal: yellow X
meaning: This lane is about to close to your direction. Move safely out of it as soon as you can.

name: Lane-use signal: green arrow
meaning: You may drive in this lane.

name: Railroad crossing flashing lights
meaning: A train is approaching. Stop before the crossing and do not cross until the lights stop flashing and the way is clear.

name: Traffic signal not working
meaning: When signals are dark (power out), treat the intersection as an all-way stop: stop, then proceed when it is your turn and safe.
